text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
What the what?! I feel like I'm<n>suddenly bursting
with power!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Could this be... the Three<n>Goddesses' doing?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wait... So the person who called me<n>that... Could it
have been?
